methodology.cached_sam_input_identity_basis: Baseline content/reference/quad snapshots are SHA-bound to the input verified report; baseline/current Detection dataclasses are compared exactly before SAM, without rounding. Changed/unresolved/review/restored/nonaccepted cases rerun real SAM. All cached finals also run current content plus observed-perimeter restoration. Accepted adapter-internal partial fallbacks are reusable only when inputs and adapter/worker hashes match: their original-quad fallback precedes the audit and no old content restoration occurred.
methodology.offline_crop_geometry: actual final SAM/restored source polygon; service output padding not run
